source: GDELT DOC 2.0 (keyless; 1 req/5s). Query = OR of the taxonomy seeds, US sources.
note: Same seeds define the news query AND our corpus match — one published topic definition, both sides. Rate limit 1 req/5s is enforced in pipeline/gdelt.py. 'other' is excluded (a catch-all cannot have a news baseline).
